title: ID0404603-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313651774001]Charge exceeds Limit of 150KWH
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Charge exceeds Limit of 150KWH
Root cause:
The issue was caused because the peak power gets calculated using the last meter value that came in before the TX profile. As soon as TX profile comes the power gets calculated using the TX profile.
Solution:  rectified from Depotfinity backend in Feb
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status:
2nd charger:
xtIIQT
Depotfinity Ticket -
EVC3-8531

additional_info.subject: Note( Reply from Depotfinity Team)
additional_info.body:
Y2/S5 313651774001
For transaction ID:
We have seen this behaviour in the portal and as we discussed with the team we got to know that there is a feature in place where as soon as the transaction starts there will be a spike to the max power and after after a minute or two minutes the spike will come down to allocated power. This is a known scenario and completely normal.
[ESPPL-4948]
Customer Defect - Smart charging Problem with ATV Verona Tenant - Jira
Y2/S5 313661877001
For transaction ID:
We have observed that the spike generated when the transaction was coming to the end and also the TX Profile is not getting generated every min. We will discuss the same with RnD team and will keep you posted.

additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
Hi Sunil Sharma ,
We will be seeing the spike because
Smart Charging Algorithm is triggered every minute, so if a charger starts the transaction in the middle of the minute, it will charge with TxDefault power, which usually will be the charger’s max power.
If there are other chargers charging in the group our algorithm will split the available power within them. So, until the next minute the already charging chargers will charge with the power determined by the algorithm and the newly started charger will charge with TxDefault and the very next minute the algorithm will set the TxProfile based on the power limit set.
So, for that few seconds alone one charger might be charging over the limit. That's why the power is spiking in one bar and not continuously peak power graph is not the actual value which is delivered.
BR,
Swastika Mishra
